title: Machine Operation Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Machine Operation Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Pre-Start Inspection-Missing guards
-Damaged cords
-Unsecured workpiece		-Amputation
-Crush injuries
-Electrocution		16 (HIGH)-Verify all guards in place
-Check emergency stops functional
-Inspect power cord for damage
-Ensure work area clear
-Secure workpiece properly
2. Machine Startup-Unexpected startup
-Tool ejection
-Vibration		-Crush injuries
-Impact
-Strikes		20 (VERY HIGH)-Test run without load
-Verify correct direction
-Check tool/tooling secure
-Stand clear during startup
3. Production Operation-Entanglement in moving parts
-Kickback
-Flying debris		-Severe lacerations
-Fractures
-Eye injury		25 (VERY HIGH)-Remove jewelry, loose clothing
-Tie back long hair
-Keep hands clear of moving parts
-Use push sticks/feeding tools
-Wear safety glasses
4. Material Handling-Pinch points
-Heavy lifting
-Repetitive motion		-Hand/finger injuries
-Muscle strain		12 (HIGH)-Use lifting equipment for heavy loads
-Maintain 3-point contact
-Position material within easy reach
-Take regular breaks
5. Shutdown & Cleanup-Sharp edges
-Hot surfaces
-Residual energy		-Cuts
-Burns
-Fire		8 (MEDIUM)-Wait for machine to stop completely
-Use lockout/tagout for cleaning
-Clean chips/swarf with tools
-Check for hot spots

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ Face Shield ☐ Hearing Protection ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves
